description: Stable mutable doubly linked lists with checked ownership, reusable indexed storage and independently retained element values.
status: Complete capability mapping, both frontend runtime/reference/ownership gates, parent Cargo targets, full self-built Native family and documented source distribution passed. Full standard-library goal remains open.

capability_mapping.func New() *List: list-new / list-with-capacity construct opaque, initialized empty roots.
capability_mapping.method (*Element) Next() *Element: list-next takes the owning root and returns checked optional membership.
capability_mapping.method (*Element) Prev() *Element: list-prev takes the owning root and returns checked optional membership.
capability_mapping.method (*List) Back() *Element: list-back returns None when empty and a stable value handle otherwise.
capability_mapping.method (*List) Front() *Element: list-front returns None when empty and a stable value handle otherwise.
capability_mapping.method (*List) Init() *List: list-clear resets the existing root, invalidates old membership and releases arena owners; the caller already retains the root value.
capability_mapping.method (*List) InsertAfter(interface{},: list-insert-after returns a new stable handle or an explicit foreign/removed/capacity error.
capability_mapping.method (*List) InsertBefore(interface{},: list-insert-before returns a new stable handle or an explicit foreign/removed/capacity error.
capability_mapping.method (*List) Len() int: list-length observes the live count in constant time.
capability_mapping.method (*List) MoveAfter(*Element, *Elem: list-move-after checks both memberships before changing links; self-movement succeeds unchanged.
capability_mapping.method (*List) MoveBefore(*Element, *Ele: list-move-before checks both memberships before changing links; self-movement succeeds unchanged.
capability_mapping.method (*List) MoveToBack(*Element): list-move-back preserves node identity, value and count.
capability_mapping.method (*List) MoveToFront(*Element): list-move-front preserves node identity, value and count.
capability_mapping.method (*List) PushBack(interface{}) *El: list-push-back creates a typed value node with a stable handle.
capability_mapping.method (*List) PushBackList(*List): list-append-list copies values in order, supports distinct mutation regions, and bounds self-copy to the original count.
capability_mapping.method (*List) PushFront(interface{}) *E: list-push-front creates a typed value node with a stable handle.
capability_mapping.method (*List) PushFrontList(*List): list-prepend-list copies values in order, supports distinct mutation regions, and bounds self-copy to the original count.
capability_mapping.method (*List) Remove(*Element) interfac: list-remove checks membership before unlinking and returns the retained typed value. Invalid handles return a named error; list-element-value still permits independent value access.
capability_mapping.type Element struct: Opaque ListElement retains only its node and identity/membership tokens; list-same-element compares stable identity even after detachment.
capability_mapping.type Element struct, Value interface{}: list-element-value and list-element-set read/write typed values independently of membership, including after removal, clearing or root destruction.
capability_mapping.type List struct: Opaque LinkedList owns indexed links, live arena slots and reusable holes. Public construction replaces uninitialized object states.

safe_language_choices: Opaque initialized constructors replace uninitialized root/object states. Empty navigation uses Option; stale/foreign membership uses module-owned Result errors before structural mutation.
Removed and cleared element handles keep independently readable/writable values. They never retain their former root or neighboring nodes; supplied value graphs remain ordinary application values.
Owner identity tokens distinguish lists; membership generation tokens distinguish clears; unbounded immutable serials distinguish removed/reused positions without counter wraparound.
Capacity naturals, including values above machine width, are checked before machine-word conversion. Invalid capacity/handle requests leave list contents unchanged.
Cross-region value copying declares both mutation effects; source values are shared through ordinary typed ownership while copied list nodes and memberships are independent.

observations: all stable fixture identities and alias relations
every retained value, including removed/cleared nodes
both navigation directions and exact named refusals
additional_controls: removed value mutation and slot reuse

benchmark.shared_machine_background: Parent CPU3 JSON gate, Base CPU1 mutable-family work, and separate-CPU functional work may overlap; shared memory/caches are not isolated.

optimization.change: Copy allocated nodes directly instead of constructing and discarding a public element handle/result wrapper for each copied node.
optimization.simd_notes: Dependent linked traversal and ordered mutations are serial. Slot indices/flags use existing inline machine-word primitives; arena growth uses the ownership-moving bulk slot transfer, not a new scalar copy loop.
